name: deeptutor
description: Agent skills for DeepTutor: the existing deeptutor-cli skill plus guided setup and troubleshooting, and building and evaluating knowledge bases for RAG.

interface.shortDescription: Personalized AI tutoring from the CLI
interface.longDescription: Skills for DeepTutor, the agent-native personalized tutoring platform. Reuses the repository's deeptutor-cli skill for capabilities, sessions, partners, notebooks and the Web app, and adds a setup skill (install, DEEPTUTOR_HOME, non-interactive init, config apply with credential env references, doctor checks, startup, upgrades and troubleshooting, following AGENT_SETUP.md) and a knowledge-base skill (embedding configuration, creating and extending KBs, hybrid search, retrieval evaluation and using KBs with deep_solve and deep_research).
defaultPrompt: Install DeepTutor and configure it with my OpenAI key from OPENAI_API_KEY
Build a DeepTutor knowledge base from my lecture PDFs
Quiz me on thermodynamics from my physics knowledge base
